scripts.title: Auto Play
scripts.author: tylenol
scripts.summary: Auto Player for Symphony Ochestra.
scripts.code:
if _G.__SYMPHONY_AP then
    local old = _G.__SYMPHONY_AP
    old.alive = false
    pcall(function() old.conn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() old.win:Destroy() end)
    _G.__SYMPHONY_AP = nil
end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = { alive = true, enabled = false, lastNote = {} }
_G.__SYMPHONY_AP = state

local function upsOf(f)
    local ok, ups = pcall(getupvalues, f)
    if not ok or type(ups) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    return ups
end

local engine, resolveErr = nil, nil
do
    local function isKeymap(t)
        for k in pairs(t) do
            return typeof(k) == 'EnumItem'
        end
        return false
    end

    local function validateLaneDown(f)
        if type(f) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        local ld = upsOf(f)
        if not ld or #ld < 13 then return nil end
        local Config = ld[8]
        if type(Config) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'PerfectWindow')) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'DefaultLaneKeys')) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[4]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[7]) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(ld[10]) ~= 'table' or type(ld[2]) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[11]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[12]) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        return { laneDown = f, Config = Config, held = ld[2] }
    end

    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        local conns = getconnections(LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal('OrchestraPadKeys'))
        local found = nil
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if found then break end
            local u = upsOf(c.Function)
            if u and type(u[1]) == 'function' and type(u[2]) == 'boolean' and type(u[3]) == 'function' then
                local bl = upsOf(u[3])
                if bl then
                    for i = 1, #bl do
                        if found then break end
                        if type(bl[i]) == 'function' then
                            local ola = upsOf(bl[i])
                            if ola then
                                for j = 1, #ola do
                                    if found then break end
                                    if type(ola[j]) == 'function' then
                                        local hit = validateLaneDown(ola[j])
                                        if hit then
                                            local keymap
                                            for k = 1, #ola do
                                                if type(ola[k]) == 'table' and isKeymap(ola[k]) then
                                                    keymap = ola[k]
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if keymap then
                                                hit.onLaneAction = bl[i]
                                                hit.keymap = keymap
                                                found = hit
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        assert(found, 'RhythmClient lane engine not found')
        return found
    end)
    if ok then engine = res else resolveErr = tostring(res) end
end
state.engine = engine

local function pressLane(lane)
    local Config = engine.Config
    local keymap = engine.keymap
    local key = Config.LaneKeys and Config.LaneKeys[lane]
    if not (key and keymap[key] == lane) then
        key = nil
        for k, v in pairs(keymap) do
            if v == lane then key = k break end
        end
    end
    if not key then return false end
    return pcall(engine.onLaneAction, nil, Enum.UserInputState.Begin, { KeyCode = key })
end

if engine then
    state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not state.alive then return end
        if not state.enabled then return end

        local ld = upsOf(engine.laneDown)
        if not ld then return end
        local clockOff, songStart, notes = ld[4], ld[7], ld[10]
        if type(clockOff) ~= 'number' or type(songStart) ~= 'number' or type(notes) ~= 'table' then return end
        local n = #notes
        if n == 0 then return end

        local Config = engine.Config
        local audioOff = (Config.AudioOffset or 0) + (LP:GetAttribute('OrchestraAudioOffset') or 0) / 1000
        local pos = (os.clock() + clockOff) - songStart - audioOff

        local goodWindow = (type(ld[11]) == 'number' and ld[11]) or (Config.GoodWindow or 0.12)
        local horizon = goodWindow + (Config.LateGrace or 0.05) - 0.02

        for i = 1, n do
            local note = notes[i]
            if type(note) == 'table' and not note.Judged then
                local t = note.Time
                if type(t) == 'number' then
                    local dt = pos - t
                    if dt >= 0 and dt <= horizon then
                        local lane = note.Lane
                        if type(lane) == 'number' and lane >= 1 and lane <= 4 then
                            if pressLane(lane) then
                                state.lastNote[lane] = { t = t, len = tonumber(note.Length) or 0 }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for lane, info in pairs(state.lastNote) do
            if pos > info.t + info.len + 0.06 then
                engine.held[lane] = nil
                state.lastNote[lane] = nil
            end
        end
    end)
    print('[SymphonyAP] engine hooked: laneDown/onLaneAction/note-list online')
else
    warn('[SymphonyAP] engine hook FAILED: ' .. tostring(resolveErr))
end

local function setEnabled(v)
    state.enabled = v
    if not v then state.lastNote = {} end
end

local function fallbackGui()
    local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name = 'SymphonyAutoplay'
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
    local btn = Instance.new('TextButton')
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, 8)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.TextSize = 16
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = 'Autoplay: OFF'
    btn.Parent = gui
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setEnabled(not state.enabled)
        btn.Text = 'Autoplay: ' .. (state.enabled and 'ON' or 'OFF')
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 84) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    end)
    state.win = { Destroy = function() gui:Destroy() end }
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI unavailable, using fallback toggle')
end

local windOk = pcall(function()
    local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/WindUI/main/dist/main.lua'))()
    assert(typeof(WindUI) == 'table' and WindUI.CreateWindow, 'WindUI load failed')

    local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Folder = 'SymphonyAutoplay',
        OpenButton = { Enabled = true, Title = 'Symphony Autoplay' },
    })
    state.win = Window

    local Tab = Window:Tab({ Title = 'Autoplay', Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone' })
    Tab:Toggle({
        Title = 'Autoplay Notes',
        Desc = 'Hits every note perfectly - holds included. Start any song and watch it play itself.',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            setEnabled(v)
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
                Content = v and 'Enabled - start or keep playing a song.' or 'Disabled.',
                Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end,
    })

    WindUI:Notify({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Content = engine and 'Engine hooked - ready to play.' or ('Hook failed: ' .. tostring(resolveErr)),
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Duration = 5,
    })
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI ready')
end)

if not windOk then fallbackGui() end

local allowedCommands = {
    greet = function(name) print("Hello, " .. name) end,
    add = function(a, b) print("Sum:", a + b) end
}

function runCommand(cmd, ...)
    if allowedCommands[cmd] then
        allowedCommands[cmd](...)
    else
        print("Command not allowed.")
    end
end

-- Example usage
runCommand("greet", "Alice")  -- Safe
runCommand("add", 5, 7)       -- Safe
runCommand("os.execute", "rm -rf /") -- Blocked

---------------- Core Variables ----------------

local isModeOn = false
local autoActive = false
local teleportOnClose = true
local hideRealBody = false
local noclipActive = false
local flyActive = false       -- Flight state
local shiftLockActive = false -- Camera lock state
local originalCF = nil 

local RealChar = nil
local FakeChar = nil
local Connections = {} 
local AnimTracks = {} 

local OfficialIDs = {
    Idle  = "rbxassetid://507766388",
    Walk  = "rbxassetid://507777826",
    Run  = "rbxassetid://507767714",
    Jump  = "rbxassetid://507765000",
    Fall  = "rbxassetid://507767968",
    Climb = "rbxassetid://507765644",
    Swim  = "rbxassetid://507784064"
}

local function LoadAnim(hum, id)
    local a = Instance.new("Animation")
    a.AnimationId = id
    return hum:LoadAnimation(a)
end

local function StopAll()
    for _, track in pairs(AnimTracks) do
        if track and track.IsPlaying then track:Stop(0.1) end
    end
end

local function ToggleMode()
    if isModeOn then
        isModeOn = false
        ToggleBtn.Text = "CLONE\nOFF"
        ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 215)
        for _, conn in pairs(Connections) do conn:Disconnect() end
        Connections = {}
        StopAll()

        if FakeChar then
            local lastCF = FakeChar:GetPrimaryPartCFrame()
            FakeChar:Destroy()
            FakeChar = nil

            if RealChar and RealChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                RealChar.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
                if teleportOnClose then
                    RealChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = lastCF
                else
                    if originalCF then
                        RealChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = originalCF
                    end
                end
                Player.Character = RealChar
                Camera.CameraSubject = RealChar.Humanoid
            end
        end
    else
        RealChar = Player.Character
        if not RealChar or not RealChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

        isModeOn = true
        ToggleBtn.Text = "CLONE\nON"
        ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)

        originalCF = RealChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        RealChar.Archivable = true
        FakeChar = RealChar:Clone()
        FakeChar.Name = "God_Clone"
        FakeChar.Parent = workspace

        if hideRealBody then
            RealChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = originalCF + Vector3.new(0, 5000, 0)
        end
        RealChar.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = true

        local fakeHum = FakeChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        local fakeRoot = FakeChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        for _, v in pairs(FakeChar:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("LocalScript") or v:IsA("Script") then v:Destroy() end
            if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                v.Anchored = false
                v.CanCollide = (v.Name == "HumanoidRootPart")
                if v.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then v.Transparency = 1 end
            end
        end

        AnimTracks.Idle  = LoadAnim(fakeHum, OfficialIDs.Idle)
        AnimTracks.Walk  = LoadAnim(fakeHum, OfficialIDs.Walk)
        AnimTracks.Run  = LoadAnim(fakeHum, OfficialIDs.Run)
        AnimTracks.Jump  = LoadAnim(fakeHum, OfficialIDs.Jump)
        AnimTracks.Fall  = LoadAnim(fakeHum, OfficialIDs.Fall)

        Camera.CameraSubject = fakeHum
        if AnimTracks.Idle then AnimTracks.Idle:Play() end

        table.insert(Connections, fakeHum.StateChanged:Connect(function(oldState, newState)
            if flyActive then return end -- Do not play normal landing animations while flying

            if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                StopAll()
                if AnimTracks.Jump then AnimTracks.Jump:Play() end
            elseif newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
                StopAll()
                if AnimTracks.Fall then AnimTracks.Fall:Play() end
            elseif newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
                StopAll()
                if AnimTracks.Idle then AnimTracks.Idle:Play() end
            end
        end))

        -- Core RenderStepped loop: handles flight and camera lock
        table.insert(Connections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not isModeOn or not fakeHum or not fakeRoot then return end

            -- Wall clipping logic
            if noclipActive then
                for _, v in pairs(FakeChar:GetDescendants()) do
                    if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CanCollide = false end
                end
            end

            -- Mobile camera lock: force the character to face the camera direction
            if shiftLockActive then
                local camLook = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
                -- Keep the Y-axis unchanged and rotate only horizontally
                local lookAtPos = fakeRoot.Position + Vector3.new(camLook.X, 0, camLook.Z)
                fakeRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(fakeRoot.Position, lookAtPos)
            end

            local currentSpeed = tonumber(SpeedBox.Text) or 16
            fakeHum.WalkSpeed = currentSpeed

            local inputVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            if Controls then
                inputVector = Controls:GetMoveVector()
            else
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then inputVector = inputVector + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then inputVector = inputVector + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then inputVector = inputVector + Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then inputVector = inputVector + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
            end

            local camCF = Camera.CFrame

            -- Flight mode logic
            if flyActive then
                fakeHum.PlatformStand = true -- Disable normal movement physics

                -- Calculate the 3D flight vector (fly in the direction the camera is facing)
                local move3D = (camCF.RightVector * inputVector.X) + (camCF.LookVector * -inputVector.Z)

                -- Use BodyVelocity for smooth flight
                local bv = fakeRoot:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity")
                if not bv then
                    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
                    bv.Name = "FlyVelocity"
                    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000) -- Ignore gravity
                    bv.Parent = fakeRoot
                end

                if move3D.Magnitude > 0 then
                    bv.Velocity = move3D.Unit * currentSpeed
                    if AnimTracks.Fall and not AnimTracks.Fall.IsPlaying then
                        StopAll()
                        AnimTracks.Fall:Play(0.1) -- Play the falling animation while flying to look like Superman
                    end
                else
                    bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) -- Hover in place
                    if AnimTracks.Idle and not AnimTracks.Idle.IsPlaying then
                        StopAll()
                        AnimTracks.Idle:Play(0.1)
                    end
                end
            else
                -- Normal walking mode
                fakeHum.PlatformStand = false
                local bv = fakeRoot:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity")
                if bv then bv:Destroy() end

                local finalDir = (camCF.RightVector * inputVector.X) + (camCF.LookVector * -inputVector.Z)
                finalDir = Vector3.new(finalDir.X, 0, finalDir.Z)

                local currentState = fakeHum:GetState()
                local isGrounded = (currentState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running or currentState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics)

                if finalDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                    fakeHum:Move(finalDir.Unit, false)
                    if isGrounded then
                        if AnimTracks.Run and not AnimTracks.Run.IsPlaying then
                            StopAll()
                            AnimTracks.Run:Play(0.1)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    fakeHum:Move(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), false)
                    if isGrounded then
                        if AnimTracks.Idle and not AnimTracks.Idle.IsPlaying then
                            StopAll()
                            AnimTracks.Idle:Play(0.1)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end))

        table.insert(Connections, UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
            if isModeOn and fakeHum and not flyActive and fakeHum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
                local currentJump = tonumber(JumpBox.Text) or 50
                fakeHum.UseJumpPower = true
                fakeHum.JumpPower = currentJump
                fakeHum.Jump = true
            end
        end))
    end
end

end)

ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if autoActive then
        autoActive = false
        AutoBtn.Text = "AUTO: OFF"
        AutoBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 185)
    end
    ToggleMode()
end)

AutoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    autoActive = not autoActive
    AutoBtn.Text = autoActive and "AUTO: ON" or "AUTO: OFF"
    AutoBtn.BackgroundColor3 = autoActive and Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 185)

    if autoActive then
        task.spawn(function()
            while autoActive do
                local onTime = tonumber(TimeBox.Text) or 5
                if not isModeOn then ToggleMode() end

                local passedTime = 0
                while passedTime < onTime and autoActive do
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    passedTime = passedTime + 0.1
                end

                if not autoActive then break end
                if isModeOn then ToggleMode() end
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- Flight World NPC-Only Auto-Teleport, Speed & Noclip (Anti-Lag Edition)
local desiredSpeed = 100
local teleportOffset = CFrame.new(0, 0, -4) -- Teleports NPC 4 studs in front of you

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local localPlayer = players.LocalPlayer
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Table to keep track of verified NPCs only
local activeNPCs = {}
local noSlipPhysics = PhysicalProperties.new(0.7, 2.0, 0.0, 100.0, 1.0)

-- Strict check to verify the model is an NPC (Not a real player, not a vehicle)
local function isActualNPC(model)
	if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then return false end
	
	-- 1. Exclude ALL real players (including yourself)
	if players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) ~= nil then
		return false
	end
	
	-- 2. Must have a Humanoid and a HumanoidRootPart
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not rootPart then
		return false
	end
	
	-- 3. Exclude vehicles/aircraft (checks for VehicleSeats or anchored root parts)
	if rootPart.Anchored or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true) then
		return false
	end
	
	return true
end

local function teleportToPlayer(npc)
	local myChar = localPlayer.Character
	local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local npcRoot = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if myRoot and npcRoot then
		npcRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		npcRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		npc:PivotTo(myRoot.CFrame * teleportOffset)
	end
end

local function processNPC(obj, shouldTeleport)
	-- Run the strict NPC filter before doing anything
	if not isActualNPC(obj) or activeNPCs[obj] then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	
	-- 1. Apply and lock WalkSpeed
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = desiredSpeed
	humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(function()
		if humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= desiredSpeed then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = desiredSpeed
		end
	end)
	
	-- 2. Cache only the NPC's BaseParts once (prevents lag from scanning descendants every frame)
	local npcParts = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CustomPhysicalProperties = noSlipPhysics
			table.insert(npcParts, part)
		end
	end
	
	-- Store humanoid and cached parts in the table
	activeNPCs[obj] = {
		humanoid = humanoid,
		rootPart = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
		parts = npcParts
	}
	
	-- 3. Teleport newly spawned NPC to you
	if shouldTeleport then
		teleportToPlayer(obj)
	end
end

-- Optimized Continuous Loop (No heavy GetDescendants() calls inside Stepped)
runService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	for npc, data in pairs(activeNPCs) do
		if npc and npc.Parent and data.humanoid then
			for _, part in ipairs(data.parts) do
				if part and part.Parent then
					part.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
			
			if data.rootPart and data.humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude == 0 then
				data.rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, data.rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
			end
		else
			activeNPCs[npc] = nil
		end
	end
end)

-- Initial scan of currently loaded NPCs (keeps them from lagging/teleporting on startup)
for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if desc:IsA("Model") then
		processNPC(desc, false)
	end
end

-- Trigger only when a new Model is added to Workspace
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
	if desc:IsA("Model") then
		task.wait(0.05)
		processNPC(desc, true)
	end
end)

print("Flight World NPC-Only Teleport & Anti-Lag Activated!")

local function GetCurrentVehicle()
    if not Character then
        return nil
    end
    local humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart then
        local vehicle = humanoid.SeatPart.Parent
        while vehicle and vehicle.Parent ~= Workspace do
            if vehicle:FindFirstChildOfClass("VehicleSeat") then
                return vehicle
            end
            vehicle = vehicle.Parent
        end
        return humanoid.SeatPart.Parent
    end
    return nil
end

local ESPTab = Window:CreateTab("ESP")
ESPTab:CreateSection("Player ESP")

local function UpdateESP()
    ESPFolder:ClearAllChildren()
    if not Toggles.ESP then
        return
    end
    for _, player in PlayersService:GetPlayers() do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local char = player.Character
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            
            if head and rootPart and humanoid then
                if Toggles.NameAndHealth then
                    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                    billboard.Name = player.Name .. "_Name"
                    billboard.Adornee = head
                    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 40)
                    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    billboard.Parent = ESPFolder
                    
                    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
                    nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    nameLabel.Text = player.Name
                    nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    nameLabel.TextScaled = true
                    nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
                    nameLabel.Parent = billboard
                    
                    local healthLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    healthLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
                    healthLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
                    healthLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    healthLabel.Text = math.floor(humanoid.Health) .. " HP"
                    healthLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)
                    healthLabel.TextScaled = true
                    healthLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
                    healthLabel.Parent = billboard
                end
                
                if Toggles.Highlight then
                    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    highlight.Name = player.Name .. "_High"
                    highlight.Adornee = char
                    highlight.FillColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
                    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.7
                    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
                    highlight.Parent = ESPFolder
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    UpdateCharacter()
    if not Humanoid then
        return

    if Toggles.LoopWalkSpeed then
        pcall(function()
            Humanoid.WalkSpeed = Settings.WalkSpeed
        end)
    end
    
    if Toggles.LoopJumpPower then
        pcall(function()
            Humanoid.JumpPower = Settings.JumpPower
            Humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
        end)
    end
    
    if Toggles.LoopGravity then
        Workspace.Gravity = Settings.Gravity
    end
    
    if Toggles.LoopVehicleBoost then
        local vehicle = GetCurrentVehicle()
        if vehicle then
            for _, descendant in vehicle:GetDescendants() do
                if descendant:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
                    descendant.MaxSpeed = 200 * Settings.VehicleBoost
                    descendant.Torque = 100 * Settings.VehicleBoost
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    if Toggles.GodMode then
        pcall(function()
            Humanoid.Health = Humanoid.MaxHealth
        end)
    end
    
    if Toggles.AntiVoid and HumanoidRootPart then
        if HumanoidRootPart.Position.Y < -50 then
            HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 50, 0)
        end
    end
    
    if Toggles.Spectating and SpectatingTarget then
        if SpectatingTarget.Parent and SpectatingTarget.Character then
            local targetHumanoid = SpectatingTarget.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local targetRoot = SpectatingTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local healthText = targetHumanoid and math.floor(targetHumanoid.Health) .. "/" .. math.floor(targetHumanoid.MaxHealth) or "N/A"
            local posText = targetRoot and string.format("%.0f,%.0f,%.0f", targetRoot.Position.X, targetRoot.Position.Y, targetRoot.Position.Z) or "N/A"
            pcall(function()
                SpectateStatusLabel:Set("Spectating: " .. SpectatingTarget.Name .. " | " .. healthText .. " | " .. posText)
            end)
        else
            StopSpectating()
        end
    else
        pcall(function()

        end)
    end
end)

--[[

	What's new

	- Priority modes, auto re-target, lock distance, smoothed prediction

	- Tracers, notifications, anti-AFK, cleaner Unload

	Menu key: RightShift (rebindable).   Search "-- HOOK" to plug in your own logic.
]]

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Services / setup
----------------------------------------------------------------------
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local PlayerGui = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- remove older copies (including the previous menu versions)
for _, n in ipairs({ "ToxicHubGui", "ToxicHubOverlay", "MenuGui", "MenuOverlay" }) do
	local old = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild(n)
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
end
pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("MenuAimLock") end)
pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ToxicAimLock") end)

local Cfg = { aimActive = false } -- every setting lives here, keyed by flag
local Setters = {} -- checkbox setters by flag (lets keybinds flip a checkbox)
local conns, cleanups = {}, {}

local function connect(signal, fn)
	local c = signal:Connect(fn)
	table.insert(conns, c)
	return c
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Theme + helpers
----------------------------------------------------------------------
local Theme = {
	Bg = Color3.fromRGB(8, 12, 8),
	Box = Color3.fromRGB(13, 20, 13),
	Tab = Color3.fromRGB(18, 27, 18),
	Dark = Color3.fromRGB(22, 33, 22),
	Hover = Color3.fromRGB(38, 58, 34),
	Border = Color3.fromRGB(34, 70, 28),
	Text = Color3.fromRGB(215, 255, 205),
	Dim = Color3.fromRGB(110, 150, 100),
	Accent = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 40), -- toxic green (changeable in Settings)
	Purple = Color3.fromRGB(170, 60, 255), -- toxic secondary
	Font = Enum.Font.Code,
}

local FAST = TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local POP = TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local function tween(o, props, info)
	TweenService:Create(o, info or FAST, props):Play()
end

local function new(class, props, children)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	local parent = props.Parent
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		if k ~= "Parent" then
			o[k] = v
		end
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(children or {}) do
		c.Parent = o
	end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end

local function stroke(color, thickness)
	return new("UIStroke", {
		Color = color or Theme.Border,
		Thickness = thickness or 1,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
	})
end

local function pad(n)
	return new("UIPadding", {
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, n), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, n),
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, n), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, n),
	})
end

local function text(props)
	props.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	props.Font = props.Font or Theme.Font
	props.TextSize = props.TextSize or 12
	props.TextColor3 = props.TextColor3 or Theme.Text
	props.TextXAlignment = props.TextXAlignment or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	return new("TextLabel", props)
end

-- accent registry (live recolor) + shimmer registry (animated gradients)
local accents, shimmers = {}, {}
local function accent(obj, prop)
	table.insert(accents, { obj = obj, prop = prop })
	obj[prop] = Theme.Accent
end
local function setAccent(c)
	Theme.Accent = c
	for i = #accents, 1, -1 do
		local a = accents[i]
		if a.obj.Parent then
			a.obj[a.prop] = c
		else
			table.remove(accents, i)
		end
	end
end
local function shimmer(frame)
	local g = new("UIGradient", {
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.7),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.7),
		}),
		Parent = frame,
	})
	table.insert(shimmers, g)
end

local function isMouse(i)
	return i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

local function inside(gui, pos)
	local p, s = gui.AbsolutePosition, gui.AbsoluteSize
	return pos.X >= p.X and pos.X <= p.X + s.X and pos.Y >= p.Y and pos.Y <= p.Y + s.Y
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GUIs
----------------------------------------------------------------------
local overlay = new("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "ToxicHubOverlay", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
	DisplayOrder = 50, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, Parent = PlayerGui,
})
local menuGui = new("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "ToxicHubGui", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
	DisplayOrder = 100, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, Parent = PlayerGui,
})

-- notifications ---------------------------------------------------------
local toastHolder = new("Frame", {
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 44), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 300), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = overlay,
}, { new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }) })

local function Notify(title, msg, color)
	local f = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Box, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = toastHolder,
	}, { stroke(color or Theme.Accent) })
	new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = color or Theme.Accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = f })
	local t = text({
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 1, 0),
		Text = ("%s  %s"):format(title, msg), Parent = f,
	})
	task.delay(2.6, function()
		if f.Parent then
			tween(f, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
			tween(t, { TextTransparency = 1 })
			task.wait(0.2)
			f:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

-- main window -------------------------------------------------------------
local main = new("Frame", {
	Name = "Main", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(430, 490), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = menuGui,
}, { stroke(Theme.Border) })
local mainStroke = main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
accent(mainStroke, "Color")

local mainScale = new("UIScale", { Parent = main })
local baseScale = 1
local function rescale()
	local vp = Camera.ViewportSize
	baseScale = math.clamp(math.min(vp.X / 470, vp.Y / 530), 0.5, 1)
	mainScale.Scale = baseScale
end
rescale()
connect(Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), rescale)

-- Modal button unlocks the mouse in first-person / shiftlock games while open
new("TextButton", { Modal = true, Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), Parent = main })

-- rising toxic bubbles (behind everything)
local bubbleLayer = new("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = main,
})
local bubbles = {}
for i = 1, 16 do
	local size = math.random(6, 16)
	local b = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), BackgroundTransparency = 0.78, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bubbleLayer,
	}, { new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }) })
	accent(b, "BackgroundColor3")
	bubbles[i] = { f = b, x = math.random(), y = math.random(), speed = 0.03 + math.random() * 0.06, phase = math.random() * 6 }
end

-- title strip ----------------------------------------------------------------
local titleBar = new("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 9, 6), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = main,
})
local titleText = text({
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 26), Text = "TOXIC HUB",
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 15, Parent = titleBar,
})
accent(titleText, "TextColor3")
local titleStroke = new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1.2, Transparency = 0.5, Parent = titleText })
accent(titleStroke, "Color")
text({
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 26),
	Text = "made by chucky", TextColor3 = Theme.Dim, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = titleBar,
})

do
	local dragging, startMouse, startPos
	connect(titleBar.InputBegan, function(i)
		if isMouse(i) then
			dragging, startMouse, startPos = true, i.Position, main.Position
		end
	end)
	connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(i)
		if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local d = (i.Position - startMouse) / mainScale.Scale
			main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
		end
	end)
	connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(i) if isMouse(i) then dragging = false end end)
end

local tabBar = new("Frame", {
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = main,
}, { new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }) })

local pageHolder = new("Frame", {
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 50), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -50),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = main,
})

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Color picker popup (shared)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
local picker = { h = 0, s = 1, v = 1, setter = nil, swatch = nil }

picker.frame = new("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 128), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Box,
	BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 50, Parent = menuGui,
}, { stroke(Theme.Border) })

picker.sv = new("Frame", {
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 116),
	BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 51, Parent = picker.frame,
})
new("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 52, Parent = picker.sv,
}, { new("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1) }) })
new("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
	BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 53, Parent = picker.sv,
}, { new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0) }) })
picker.svCursor = new("Frame", {
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ZIndex = 55, Parent = picker.sv,
}, { stroke(Color3.new(0, 0, 0)) })

local hueKeys = {}
for i = 0, 6 do
	table.insert(hueKeys, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 6, Color3.fromHSV(math.min(i / 6, 0.999), 1, 1)))
end
picker.hue = new("Frame", {
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(142, 6), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 116),
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 51, Parent = picker.frame,
}, { new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(hueKeys) }) })
picker.hueCursor = new("Frame", {
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2),
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ZIndex = 55, Parent = picker.hue,
}, { stroke(Color3.new(0, 0, 0)) })

local function applyPicker()
	local c = Color3.fromHSV(picker.h, picker.s, picker.v)
	picker.sv.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(picker.h, 1, 1)
	picker.svCursor.Position = UDim2.fromScale(picker.s, 1 - picker.v)
	picker.hueCursor.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, picker.h)
	if picker.setter then
		picker.setter(c)
	end
end

local pickDrag
local function pickUpdate(input)
	if pickDrag == "sv" then
		picker.s = math.clamp((input.Position.X - picker.sv.AbsolutePosition.X) / picker.sv.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		picker.v = 1 - math.clamp((input.Position.Y - picker.sv.AbsolutePosition.Y) / picker.sv.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0, 1)
	elseif pickDrag == "hue" then
		picker.h = math.clamp((input.Position.Y - picker.hue.AbsolutePosition.Y) / picker.hue.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0, 0.999)
	end
	applyPicker()
end

connect(picker.sv.InputBegan, function(i) if isMouse(i) then pickDrag = "sv"; pickUpdate(i) end end)
connect(picker.hue.InputBegan, function(i) if isMouse(i) then pickDrag = "hue"; pickUpdate(i) end end)
connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(i)
	if pickDrag and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		pickUpdate(i)
	end
end)
connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(i) if isMouse(i) then pickDrag = nil end end)
connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(i)
	if picker.frame.Visible and isMouse(i) then
		if not inside(picker.frame, i.Position) and not (picker.swatch and inside(picker.swatch, i.Position)) then
			picker.frame.Visible = false
		end
	end
end)

local function openPicker(swatch, color, setter)
	picker.setter = nil
	picker.swatch = swatch
	picker.h, picker.s, picker.v = color:ToHSV()
	local vp = Camera.ViewportSize
	local p = swatch.AbsolutePosition
	local w = picker.frame.AbsoluteSize.X
	picker.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
		math.clamp(p.X - w + swatch.AbsoluteSize.X, 4, vp.X - w - 4),
		math.clamp(p.Y + 16, 4, vp.Y - 140)
	)
	picker.frame.Visible = true
	picker.setter = setter
	applyPicker()
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Widgets

local UI = {}
local listening -- keybind currently waiting for input

	return new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = parent })

	Cfg[flag] = default
	local sw = new("TextButton", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -posOffset, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 11), BackgroundColor3 = default, Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = parent,
	}, { stroke(Theme.Border) })
	connect(sw.MouseButton1Click, function()
		openPicker(sw, Cfg[flag], function(c)
			Cfg[flag] = c
			sw.BackgroundColor3 = c
			if callback then callback(c) end
		end)
	end)
	return sw
end

function UI.Checkbox(parent, o)
	Cfg[o.Flag] = o.Default or false
	local colors = o.Colors or {}
	local n = #colors
	local r = row(parent, 18)
	local box = new("Frame", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 3), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Dark, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = r,
	}, { stroke(Theme.Border) })
	local fill = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = box,
	})
	accent(fill, "BackgroundColor3")
	text({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -22 - n * 30, 1, 0), Text = o.Text, Parent = r })

	local function render()
		tween(fill, { Size = Cfg[o.Flag] and UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12) or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) })
	end
	render()

	local function set(v)
		Cfg[o.Flag] = v
		render()
		if o.Callback then o.Callback(v) end
	end
	Setters[o.Flag] = set

	local hit = new("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -n * 30, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", Parent = r,
	})
	connect(hit.MouseButton1Click, function() set(not Cfg[o.Flag]) end)
	for i, c in ipairs(colors) do
		makeSwatch(r, c.Flag, c.Default, (i - 1) * 30 + 2, c.Callback)
	end
end

function UI.ColorRow(parent, o)

	local bar = new("Frame", {

	local fill = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bar,
	}, {
		new("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(40, 190, 30), Color3.fromRGB(170, 255, 40)) }),
	})
	local lbl = text({
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
		TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5, ZIndex = 2, Parent = bar,
	})

	local function render()
		local v = Cfg[o.Flag]
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale((v - o.Min) / (o.Max - o.Min), 1)
		lbl.Text = ("%s%s/%s%s"):format(v, suffix, o.Max, suffix)
	end
	render()

	local dragging = false
	local function fromInput(i)
		local a = math.clamp((i.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		Cfg[o.Flag] = math.floor(o.Min + (o.Max - o.Min) * a + 0.5)
		render()
		if o.Callback then o.Callback(Cfg[o.Flag]) end
	end
	local hit = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", ZIndex = 3, Parent = bar })
	connect(hit.InputBegan, function(i) if isMouse(i) then dragging = true; fromInput(i) end end)
	connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(i)
		if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			fromInput(i)
		end
	end)
	connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(i) if isMouse(i) then dragging = false end end)
end

function UI.Dropdown(parent, o)
	Cfg[o.Flag] = o.Default or o.Options[1]
	local OPT_H = 18
	local holder = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = parent,
	})
	text({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = o.Text, Parent = holder })
	local head = new("TextButton", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 16), Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 20),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Dark, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = holder,
	}, { stroke(Theme.Border) })
	local sel = text({ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0), Text = Cfg[o.Flag], Parent = head })
	local arrow = text({
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 20),
		Text = "▼", TextSize = 9, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Parent = head,
	})
	local list = new("Frame", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 38), Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, #o.Options * OPT_H),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Dark, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = holder,
	}, { stroke(Theme.Border), new("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }) })

	local open = false
	local function setOpen(v)
		open = v
		arrow.Text = v and "▲" or "▼"
		tween(holder, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, v and (40 + #o.Options * OPT_H) or 38) })
	end
	for i, opt in ipairs(o.Options) do
		local b = new("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, OPT_H), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Dark, Text = "  " .. opt,
			Font = Theme.Font, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = list,
		})
		connect(b.MouseEnter, function() b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Hover end)
		connect(b.MouseLeave, function() b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Dark end)
		connect(b.MouseButton1Click, function()
			Cfg[o.Flag] = opt
			sel.Text = opt
			setOpen(false)
			if o.Callback then o.Callback(opt) end
		end)
	end
	connect(head.MouseButton1Click, function() setOpen(not open) end)
end

local function groupbox(parent, title)

		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,

	local inner = new("Frame", {

		text({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Text = title, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Parent = inner })

local function tabGroupbox(parent, names)
	local inner = groupbox(parent, nil)
	local bar = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = inner },
		{ new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal }) })
	local buttons, containers = {}, {}
	local function select(idx)
		for i, b in ipairs(buttons) do
			b.BackgroundColor3 = (i == idx) and Theme.Box or Theme.Tab
			b.TextColor3 = (i == idx) and Theme.Text or Theme.Dim
			containers[i].Visible = (i == idx)
		end
	end
	for i, n in ipairs(names) do
		buttons[i] = new("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1 / #names, 0, 1, 0), Text = n, Font = Theme.Font, TextSize = 12,
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Tab, TextColor3 = Theme.Dim, AutoButtonColor = false,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bar,
		}, { stroke(Theme.Border) })
		containers[i] = new("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = inner,
		}, { new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }) })
		connect(buttons[i].MouseButton1Click, function() select(i) end)
	end
	select(1)
	return containers
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Feature helpers
----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function sameTeam(plr)
	return LP.Team ~= nil and plr.Team == LP.Team
end

local function isDown(bind)
	if not bind then return false end
	if bind.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode then
		return UIS:IsKeyDown(bind)
	end
	return UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(bind)
end

local function matches(input, bind)
	if not bind then return false end
	if bind.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode then
		return input.KeyCode == bind
	end
	return input.UserInputType == bind
end

local function alive(plr)
	local char = plr.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if hum and root and head and hum.Health > 0 then
		return char, hum, root, head
	end
end

-- thin line between two screen points (used for tracers + lock tether)
local function setLine(frame, a, b, thickness)
	local d = b - a
	frame.Visible = true
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d.Magnitude, thickness)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((a.X + b.X) / 2, (a.Y + b.Y) / 2)
	frame.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, d.X))
end

-- radar-style edge position for something that is off screen
local function edgePosition(worldPos, radiusScale)
	local vp = Camera.ViewportSize
	local rel = Camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(worldPos)
	local d = Vector2.new(rel.X, rel.Z)
	if d.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		d = Vector2.new(0, -1)
	end
	local u = d.Unit
	return vp / 2 + u * (math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) * radiusScale), math.deg(math.atan2(u.X, -u.Y))
end

local function applyCham(holder, key, char, show, fill, outline, fillT, outT, walls)
	if show and char then
		if not holder[key] or holder[key].Parent ~= char then
			if holder[key] then holder[key]:Destroy() end
			holder[key] = new("Highlight", { Parent = char })
		end
		local h = holder[key]
		h.Enabled = true
		h.FillColor, h.OutlineColor = fill, outline
		h.FillTransparency, h.OutlineTransparency = fillT, outT
		h.DepthMode = walls and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
	elseif holder[key] then
		holder[key].Enabled = false
	end
end

local function updateEsp()
	local vp = Camera.ViewportSize
	local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
	local tracerFrom = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)

	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= LP then
			local e = espObjs[plr]

				e = makeEsp()
				espObjs[plr] = e
			end
			hideEsp(e)

			local char, hum, root, head = alive(plr)
			local enemy = char and not (Cfg.espTeam and sameTeam(plr))

			applyCham(e, "cham", char, enemy and Cfg.cham, Cfg.chamFill, Cfg.chamOutline,
				Cfg.chamFillT / 100, Cfg.chamOutT / 100, Cfg.chamWalls)

				local dist = (root.Position - camPos).Magnitude
				if dist <= Cfg.espMaxDist then

					if on then
						local topP = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, head.Size.Y / 2 + 0.15, 0))
						local botP = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
						local h = math.abs(botP.Y - topP.Y)

						if Cfg.espBox then

							e.stroke.Color = Cfg.espBoxColor

						if Cfg.espName then

							e.nameL.TextColor3 = Cfg.espNameColor
							e.nameL.TextSize = Cfg.espTextSize
							e.nameL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, y0 - 2)

							e.distL.TextColor3 = Cfg.espNameColor
							e.distL.TextSize = Cfg.espTextSize

							e.hpBack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0 - 6, y0)
							e.hpBack.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h)
							e.hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, frac)
							e.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0.15, 0.15):Lerp(Cfg.espHealthColor, frac)
						end
						if Cfg.espTracer then
							e.tracer.BackgroundColor3 = Cfg.espTracerColor
							setLine(e.tracer, tracerFrom, Vector2.new(cx, botP.Y), 1)
						end
					elseif Cfg.espArrows then
						local pos, rot = edgePosition(root.Position, 0.4)
						e.arrow.Visible = true
						e.arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y)
						e.arrow.Rotation = rot

		end

	-- local player visualization
	local lchar = LP.Character
	applyCham(localHolder, "cham", lchar, Cfg.localCham, Cfg.localChamColor, Cfg.localChamColor,
		Cfg.localChamT / 100, 0, false)

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- AIM LOCK (toggle / hold, persistent tracking)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.IgnoreWater = true

local lockedPlayer
local lockVel = Vector3.zero
local lastAcquire = 0

local function targetPart(char)
	return char:FindFirstChild(Cfg.aimPart) or char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function isVisible(part)
	local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
	local res = Workspace:Raycast(origin, part.Position - origin, rayParams)
	return res == nil or res.Instance:IsDescendantOf(part.Parent)
end

local function setLock(plr)
	lockedPlayer = plr
	local char = plr.Character
	local part = char and targetPart(char)
	lockVel = part and part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
	if Cfg.lockFx then
		lockFlash.BackgroundColor3 = Cfg.lockColor
		lockFlash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
		tween(lockFlash, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, TweenInfo.new(0.45))
	end
	if Cfg.lockNotify then
		Notify("TOXIC LOCK", "locked » " .. plr.DisplayName, Cfg.lockColor)
	end
end

-- pick the best visible enemy inside the acquire FOV
local function acquire()
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LP.Character }
	local mouse = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
	local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
	local bestPlr, bestScore
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= LP then
			local char, hum = alive(plr)
			if char and not (Cfg.aimTeam and sameTeam(plr)) then
				local part = targetPart(char)
				if part then
					local worldDist = (part.Position - camPos).Magnitude
					if worldDist <= Cfg.aimMaxDist then
						local sp, on = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
						local screenDist = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - mouse).Magnitude
						if on and screenDist <= Cfg.aimFov and (not Cfg.aimWall or isVisible(part)) then
							local score = screenDist
							if Cfg.aimPriority == "Closest Distance" then
								score = worldDist
							elseif Cfg.aimPriority == "Lowest Health" then
								score = hum.Health
							end
							if not bestScore or score < bestScore then
								bestScore, bestPlr = score, plr
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestPlr
end

local function lockValid(plr)
	local char = alive(plr)
	if not char then return end
	if Cfg.aimTeam and sameTeam(plr) then return end
	local part = targetPart(char)
	if not part then return end
	if (part.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude > Cfg.aimMaxDist * 1.25 then return end
	if Cfg.aimDropWall and not isVisible(part) then return end
	return part
end

local function setAim(on, silent)
	if on == Cfg.aimActive then return end
	Cfg.aimActive = on
	if on then
		local plr = acquire()
		if plr then
			setLock(plr)
		elseif Cfg.aimRetarget then
			if not silent and Cfg.lockNotify then Notify("TOXIC LOCK", "armed - searching...", Cfg.lockColor) end
		else
			Cfg.aimActive = false
			if not silent and Cfg.lockNotify then Notify("TOXIC LOCK", "no target in FOV", Theme.Purple) end
		end
	else
		lockedPlayer = nil
		if not silent and Cfg.lockNotify then Notify("TOXIC LOCK", "released", Theme.Dim) end
	end
end

RunService:BindToRenderStep("ToxicAimLock", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
	if Cfg.aimMode == "Hold" then
		local down = Cfg.aimOn and isDown(Cfg.aimKey)
		if down ~= Cfg.aimActive then setAim(down, true) end
	end
	if Cfg.aimActive and not Cfg.aimOn then
		setAim(false)
	end
	if not Cfg.aimActive then return end

	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LP.Character }

	-- validate / re-acquire (the lock does NOT care whether the target is on screen)
	local part = lockedPlayer and lockValid(lockedPlayer)
	if not part then
		if lockedPlayer then
			lockedPlayer = nil
			if Cfg.lockNotify then Notify("TOXIC LOCK", "target lost", Theme.Purple) end
		end
		if Cfg.aimRetarget then
			if os.clock() - lastAcquire > 0.1 then
				lastAcquire = os.clock()
				local plr = acquire()
				if plr then setLock(plr) end
			end
		elseif Cfg.aimMode == "Toggle" then
			setAim(false, true)
		end
		return
	end

	-- smoothed prediction
	lockVel = lockVel:Lerp(part.AssemblyLinearVelocity, math.clamp(dt * 10, 0, 1))
	local aimPos = part.Position + lockVel * (Cfg.aimPredict / 100) * 0.25

	-- aim: strength scales with angular error, so a target who runs off screen is caught up to hard
	local camCF = Camera.CFrame
	local toTarget = aimPos - camCF.Position
	if toTarget.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
	local angle = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(camCF.LookVector:Dot(toTarget.Unit), -1, 1)))
	local base = math.clamp(dt * 60 / math.max(Cfg.aimSmooth, 1), 0, 1)
	local alpha = math.clamp(base * (1 + angle * Cfg.aimCatch / 20), 0, 1)
	Camera.CFrame = camCF:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(camCF.Position, aimPos), alpha)
	-- HOOK: fire your own "target locked" logic here (lockedPlayer / part are valid)
end)
table.insert(cleanups, function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ToxicAimLock") end)

local function updateLockFx(t)
	local char = Cfg.aimActive and Cfg.lockFx and lockedPlayer and lockedPlayer.Character
	local part = char and targetPart(char)
	if not part then
		lockRing.Visible, lockRing2.Visible, lockTether.Visible = false, false, false
		lockLabel.Visible, lockArrow.Visible, lockHL.Enabled = false, false, false
		return
	end

	local col = Cfg.lockColor
	local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 6)

	lockHL.Adornee = char
	lockHL.Enabled = true
	lockHL.FillColor = col
	lockHL.FillTransparency = 0.5 + 0.3 * pulse
	lockHL.OutlineTransparency = 0.1

	local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
	local pos, rot
	if onScreen then
		pos = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
	else
		pos, rot = edgePosition(part.Position, 0.36)
	end

	lockRing.Visible, lockRing2.Visible = onScreen, onScreen
	lockArrow.Visible = not onScreen
	if onScreen then
		lockRing.Position, lockRing2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y), UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y)
		lockRing.Rotation, lockRing2.Rotation = t * 140, -t * 200
		local s = 46 + 8 * pulse
		lockRing.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s, s)
		lockRing.UIStroke.Color = col
	else
		lockArrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y)
		lockArrow.Rotation = rot
		lockArrow.TextColor3 = col
	end

	if Cfg.lockTether then
		lockTether.BackgroundColor3 = col
		setLine(lockTether, UIS:GetMouseLocation(), pos, 1.5)
	else
		lockTether.Visible = false
	end

	local dist = (part.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
	lockLabel.Visible = true
	lockLabel.Text = ("LOCKED » %s [%d]"):format(lockedPlayer.DisplayName, dist)
	lockLabel.TextColor3 = col
	lockLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y + (onScreen and 30 or 24))
end

-- Per-frame HUD + animated menu effects
----------------------------------------------------------------------
local frames, lastT = 0, os.clock()
local function updateHud(t, dt)
	local vp = Camera.ViewportSize
	local mouse = UIS:GetMouseLocation()

	fovCircle.Visible = Cfg.aimOn and Cfg.showFov
	if fovCircle.Visible then
		fovCircle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
		fovCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Cfg.aimFov * 2, Cfg.aimFov * 2)
		fovCircle.UIStroke.Color = Cfg.fovColor
	end

	local on = Cfg.chOn
	for _, f in pairs(cross) do
		f.Visible = on
		f.BackgroundColor3 = Cfg.chColor
	end
	cross.dot.Visible = on and Cfg.chDot
	if on then
		local p = Cfg.chAttach and mouse or (vp / 2)
		local len, sp = Cfg.chSize, Cfg.chSpacing
		cross.left.Position, cross.left.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X - sp, p.Y), UDim2.fromOffset(len, 2)
		cross.right.Position, cross.right.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X + sp, p.Y), UDim2.fromOffset(len, 2)
		cross.up.Position, cross.up.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y - sp), UDim2.fromOffset(2, len)
		cross.down.Position, cross.down.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y + sp), UDim2.fromOffset(2, len)
		cross.dot.Position, cross.dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y), UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
	end

	frames += 1
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastT >= 0.5 then
		local status = "off"
		if Cfg.aimActive then
			status = lockedPlayer and "locked" or "armed"
		end
		wmText.Text = ("TOXIC HUB | %d fps | aim: %s"):format(math.floor(frames / (now - lastT) + 0.5), status)
		frames, lastT = 0, now
	end
	watermark.Visible = Cfg.watermark

	-- animated menu effects (only while the menu is open)
	if main.Visible then
		for i = #shimmers, 1, -1 do
			local g = shimmers[i]
			if g.Parent then
				g.Offset = Vector2.new(((t * 0.6) % 2) - 1, 0)
			else
				table.remove(shimmers, i)
			end
		end
		titleStroke.Transparency = 0.35 + 0.3 * math.sin(t * 3)
		bubbleLayer.Visible = Cfg.bubblesOn
		if Cfg.bubblesOn then
			for _, b in ipairs(bubbles) do
				b.y -= b.speed * dt
				if b.y < -0.05 then
					b.y, b.x = 1.05, math.random()
				end
				b.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(b.x + 0.015 * math.sin(t * 1.5 + b.phase), b.y)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- fly ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local fly = { att = nil, lv = nil, ao = nil, vel = Vector3.zero }

local function stopFly()
	for _, k in ipairs({ "lv", "ao", "att" }) do
		if fly[k] then
			fly[k]:Destroy()
			fly[k] = nil
		end
	end
	fly.vel = Vector3.zero
	local hum = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then
		hum.PlatformStand = false
		hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
	end
end

local function startFly(root)
	stopFly()
	fly.att = new("Attachment", { Name = "ToxicFlyAttachment", Parent = root })
	fly.lv = new("LinearVelocity", {
		Attachment0 = fly.att, MaxForce = math.huge,
		VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector,
		RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World, VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero, Parent = root,
	})
	fly.ao = new("AlignOrientation", {
		Attachment0 = fly.att, Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment,
		MaxTorque = math.huge, Responsiveness = 40, CFrame = root.CFrame, Parent = root,
	})
end

local function updateFly(hum, root, dt)
	if Cfg.fly and hum and root then
		if not fly.att or fly.att.Parent ~= root then
			startFly(root)
		end
		hum.PlatformStand = true

		local cf = Camera.CFrame
		local dir = Vector3.zero
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += cf.LookVector end
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= cf.LookVector end
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += cf.RightVector end
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= cf.RightVector end
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end
		if dir.Magnitude == 0 and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
			dir = hum.MoveDirection -- touch / gamepad
		end

		local target = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * Cfg.flySpeed or Vector3.zero
		fly.vel = fly.vel:Lerp(target, math.clamp(dt * Cfg.flySmooth, 0, 1))
		fly.lv.VectorVelocity = fly.vel

		-- stay upright, face where the camera faces
		local look = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
		if look.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			fly.ao.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + look)
		end
	elseif fly.att then
		stopFly()
	end
end

	if listening then

		if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
			bind = input.KeyCode
		elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2

scripts.title: [open source] chukunhax auto throw perfect throw fast throw
scripts.author: chukunhax
scripts.summary: chukunhax, keyless , open source auto throw throw perfect fast throw throw foods at animals / throw foods for animals auto farm easy xeno solara
scripts.code:
getgenv().chukunhax = {
	autothrow = true,
	perfectthrow = true,
	fastthrow = true,
	fastspeed = 3,
}

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if type(env.chukunhax_stop) == "function" then pcall(env.chukunhax_stop) end

local chukunhax = env.chukunhax or {}
env.chukunhax = chukunhax
for key, value in pairs({ autothrow = false, perfectthrow = false, fastthrow = false, fastspeed = 3 }) do
	if chukunhax[key] == nil then chukunhax[key] = value end
end

local token = {}
env.chukunhax_token = token
local undo = {}
local function alive() return env.chukunhax_token == token end

env.chukunhax_stop = function()
	env.chukunhax_token = nil
	for i = #undo, 1, -1 do pcall(undo[i]) end
end

local lp = players.LocalPlayer
local function load(inst)
	local ok, module = pcall(require, inst)
	return ok and module or nil
end

local controllers = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("Client"):WaitForChild("Controllers")
local shared = rs:WaitForChild("Shared")
local state = load(controllers:WaitForChild("ClientState"))
local meter = load(controllers:WaitForChild("ThrowMeter"))
local game_config = load(rs:WaitForChild("Config"):WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local meter_math = load(shared:WaitForChild("ThrowMeterMath"))
local arc = load(shared:WaitForChild("ProjectileMath"))
local anim = load(shared:WaitForChild("AnimationLibrary"))

local function speed()
	return chukunhax.fastspeed * (0.94 + math.random() * 0.12)
end

local function character()
	local char = lp.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then return char, root, hum end
end

local function loop(delay, fn)
	task.spawn(function()
		while alive() do
			pcall(fn)
			task.wait(delay)
		end
	end)
end

local orig_arc = arc and arc.CreateArc
if orig_arc then
	arc.CreateArc = function(a, b, time, ...)
		if chukunhax.fastthrow and type(time) == "number" then
			time = math.max(0.35, time / speed())
		end
		return orig_arc(a, b, time, ...)
	end
	undo[#undo + 1] = function() arc.CreateArc = orig_arc end
end

local orig_play = anim and anim.Play
if orig_play then
	anim.Play = function(rig, id, ...)
		local track = orig_play(rig, id, ...)
		if chukunhax.fastthrow and track and id == anim.GetThrowId() then
			pcall(track.AdjustSpeed, track, speed())
		end
		return track
	end
	undo[#undo + 1] = function() anim.Play = orig_play end
end

local sequence_keys = { "FadeIn", "FadeOut", "POVDuration", "RevealZoomNormal", "RevealZoomDramatic", "ShowTimeNormal", "ShowTimeShort", "SkipAfterRevealDelay" }
local sequence_original

local function sync_sequence()
	local sequence = game_config and game_config.Sequence
	if not sequence then return end
	if not sequence_original then
		sequence_original = {}
		for _, key in ipairs(sequence_keys) do sequence_original[key] = sequence[key] end
		undo[#undo + 1] = function()
			for key, value in pairs(sequence_original) do sequence[key] = value end
		end
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(sequence_keys) do
		if sequence_original[key] then
			sequence[key] = chukunhax.fastthrow and math.max(0.08, sequence_original[key] / chukunhax.fastspeed) or sequence_original[key]
		end
	end
end

local function sync_meter()
	if not (meter and meter_math) then return end
	if chukunhax.perfectthrow then
		meter.TestAutoTap = meter_math.HalfPeriod() - (0.005 + math.random() * 0.002)
	else
		meter.TestAutoTap = nil
	end
end
undo[#undo + 1] = function() if meter then meter.TestAutoTap = nil end end

local last_distance, last_progress = math.huge, os.clock()

local function walk_to(pos, tolerance)
	local _, root, hum = character()
	if not root or root.Anchored then return false end
	local flat = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - pos.X, 0, root.Position.Z - pos.Z).Magnitude
	if flat <= tolerance then
		last_distance, last_progress = math.huge, os.clock()
		return true
	end
	hum:MoveTo(pos)
	if flat < last_distance - 1 then
		last_distance, last_progress = flat, os.clock()
	elseif os.clock() - last_progress > 3 then
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
		last_distance, last_progress = math.huge, os.clock()
	end
	return false
end

local function throw_target()
	local area = workspace:FindFirstChild("StarterArea")
	if not area then return end
	local line = area:FindFirstChild("CrossLine")
	local z = line and line.Position.Z or area.Position.Z + area.Size.Z / 2
	local _, root = character()
	local x = root and math.clamp(root.Position.X, area.Position.X - area.Size.X / 2 + 3, area.Position.X + area.Size.X / 2 - 3) or area.Position.X
	return Vector3.new(x, area.Position.Y + area.Size.Y / 2 + 3, z - 3)
end

loop(0.35, function()
	sync_meter()
	sync_sequence()
	local _, root = character()
	if not root or not chukunhax.autothrow then return end
	if state and (state.Busy or state.OfflineOpen) or root.Anchored then return end
	local target = throw_target()
	if target then walk_to(target, 1.5) end
end)

            Url = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:generateContent?key=" .. Api_Gemini67,
            Method = "POST",
            Headers = {

            },
            Body = body
        })
    end)
    
    if not success then
        return "Error: Request failed - " .. tostring(response)
    end

        return "Error: No response from server"
    end

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

local dropdownOptions = {"Claude", "Gpt-4", "Gemini", "(Groq) Llama", "(Groq) Gpt Oss"}


local function createDropdownOptions()
    local totalHeight = 0
    
    for index, option in ipairs(dropdownOptions) do
        local optionButton = Instance.new("TextButton", G2L["DropdownScroll"])
        optionButton["BorderSizePixel"] = 0
        optionButton["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        optionButton["Size"] = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 28)
        optionButton["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, (index - 1) * 28 + 4)
        optionButton["Text"] = option
        optionButton["TextSize"] = 12
        optionButton["TextColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        optionButton["FontFace"] = Font.new([[rbxasset://fonts/families/ComicNeueAngular.json]], Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
        optionButton["ZIndex"] = 27
        
        local optionCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", optionButton)
        optionCorner["CornerRadius"] = UDim.new(0, 3)
        
        optionButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            optionButton["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
        end)
        
        optionButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            optionButton["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        end)
        
        optionButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            currentAI = option
            G2L["TextButton_SelectAI"]["Text"] = option
            G2L["TextBox_f"]["PlaceholderText"] = "Ask " .. option .. " anything..."
            G2L["DropdownFrame"]["Visible"] = false
            
            AddMessage("System", "Switched to " .. option .. " AI model", false)
        end)
        
        totalHeight = totalHeight + 28
    end
    
    G2L["DropdownScroll"]["CanvasSize"] = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, totalHeight + 8)
end

    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        if G2L["DropdownFrame"]["Visible"] then
            local mouse = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
            local ddFrame = G2L["DropdownFrame"]
            local buttonSize = G2L["TextButton_SelectAI"].AbsoluteSize
            local buttonPos = G2L["TextButton_SelectAI"].AbsolutePosition
            local ddSize = ddFrame.AbsoluteSize
            local ddPos = ddFrame.AbsolutePosition
            
            local mouseX = mouse.X
            local mouseY = mouse.Y
            
            if not (mouseX >= buttonPos.X and mouseX <= buttonPos.X + buttonSize.X and
                    mouseY >= buttonPos.Y and mouseY <= buttonPos.Y + buttonSize.Y) and
               not (mouseX >= ddPos.X and mouseX <= ddPos.X + ddSize.X and
                    mouseY >= ddPos.Y and mouseY <= ddPos.Y + ddSize.Y) then
                G2L["DropdownFrame"]["Visible"] = false
            end
        end
    end
end)

G2L["ImageButton_11"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if isAIResponding then
        isAIResponding = false
        if currentAIRequest then
            task.cancel(currentAIRequest)
            currentAIRequest = nil
        end
        
        UpdateSendIcon("circle-arrow-up", Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0))
    
        for _, child in ipairs(G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "LoadingMessage" then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end
        
        AddMessage("System", "...", false)
        return
    end
    
    local userMessage = G2L["TextBox_f"].Text
    if userMessage:gsub("%s+", "") == "" then return end
    
    AddMessage("You", userMessage, true)
    G2L["TextBox_f"].Text = ""
    
    UpdateSendIcon("circle-stop", Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
    
    isAIResponding = true
    local loadingMessage, stopAnimation = ShowLoadingMessage()
    
    currentAIRequest = task.spawn(function()
        local aiResponse = CallAI(userMessage)
        
        if isAIResponding then  
            stopAnimation()
            
            if loadingMessage and loadingMessage.Parent then
                loadingMessage:Destroy()
            end
            
            DisplayAIResponse(aiResponse)
        end


        isAIResponding = false
        currentAIRequest = nil
        UpdateSendIcon("circle-arrow-up", Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0))
    end)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

			BackgroundTransparency = 1

local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do

			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField

			obj.CastShadow = false

local function fireproximityprompt(Obj, Amount, Skip)
    if Obj.ClassName == "ProximityPrompt" then 
        Amount = Amount or 1
        local PromptTime = Obj.HoldDuration
        if Skip then 
            Obj.HoldDuration = 0
        end
        for i = 1, Amount do 
            Obj:InputHoldBegin()
            if not Skip then 
                wait(Obj.HoldDuration)
            end
            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else 
        error("userdata<ProximityPrompt> expected")
    end
